value.title: Bad Standing
value.synopsis: After the tragic death of his daughter, Suga, the leader of a notorious motorcycle gang, struggles to keep his family and his gang together. With rival gangs and a ruthless prosecutor hot on his heels, Suga's world collapses when his own brotherhood betrays him. Now he faces an impossible choice: reclaim his power or protect his grieving family.

value.title: Solo
value.synopsis: Suga has been given a 'bad standing' by his own club and seeks new allies to recover the lost drugs. Lynn tries to rebuild the failed case against Suga, while she and her niece are haunted by a past in which Suga played a key role. Marcel will have to prove where his loyalties lie: will he choose the club, or will he protect his family?

value.title: Devil's dilemma
value.synopsis: Candy desperately searches for the missing Melissa, while Suga continues his hunt for the missing drugs. As they reunite to find their daughter, they uncover shocking secrets that completely upend both their family ties and the dynamics within the club. Meanwhile, Lynn's addiction poses a grave danger not only to herself but also to her young niece, Zoë.

value.title: Angels do not exist
value.synopsis: Suga has little time to save his daughter Melissa, but simultaneously sees an opportunity for revenge on Spike. Spike reveals his secret alliance with an unexpected ally and carries out his own plan. As tensions rise, Candy takes matters into her own hands, forcing Suga and Spike to a final confrontation, where the truth finally comes to light.

value.title: Deal with the devil
value.synopsis: Suga embarks on a risky mission to rescue Melissa, but first he must win back his old club and face his old enemy. Lynn's problems mount as her secret collaboration threatens to be exposed, forcing her to make a pact with Suga to protect their families. Ultimately, all secrets and loyalties are tested in a deadly confrontation.
